policyStatement: Patchwork may suggest supported candidates and draft seller questions; it may not contact, purchase, or claim compatibility without implemented controls and named authority.

threatHarms.harm: ranking or explanation follows untrusted seller instructions
contact or purchase without confirmed authority
control behavior changes without evidence renewal

controls.objective: treat seller content as inert data
controls.implementation: structured field extraction plus instruction-token quarantine
controls.test: seller-manipulation fixture cannot change policy or tool state
controls.residual: novel manipulation can evade known token patterns

controls.objective: enforce source permission before evidence use
controls.test: denied evidence never reaches candidate or trace payload
controls.residual: upstream permission metadata can be wrong

controls.implementation: deterministic revision and unit invariant plus evidence minimum
controls.residual: rules do not cover ambiguous legacy variants

controls.objective: separate typed provider output from trusted semantics
controls.implementation: schema, referential, permission, compatibility, and behavior-state validation
controls.test: valid schema with invalid evidence is rejected
controls.residual: semantic validators remain bounded by their encoded invariants

controls.implementation: draft-only tool proposal followed by permission, validation, explicit confirmation, idempotency, effect ledger, and recovery
controls.test: unconfirmed draft produces no effect and unknown outcome reconciles before retry
controls.authority: user confirmation plus named tool authority

controls.implementation: allowlisted audit event with version, decision, state, and evidence identifiers
controls.test: raw prompt, output, image, and identity fields are removed
controls.residual: structured identifiers can still enable linkage

humanReview.trigger: ambiguous legacy variant or unresolved effect
humanReview.evidence: redacted trace, evidence IDs, versions, failed invariants
humanReview.decisionRights: recommend correction or scope; cannot self-authorize release
humanReview.escalation: product, domain, privacy, security, or release authority as applicable

residualDecision.issue: ambiguous legacy variants remain outside deterministic compatibility coverage
residualDecision.allowedEngineerDisposition: reduce scope or request authority decision

limitations: Synthetic controls do not establish security, privacy, safety, compliance, or legal sufficiency
